remarks: Now completed and priced to sell! Enjoy living in this super stylish and roomy 5-7 bedroom farmhouse in desirable 'walk-to-everything' hip Saugatuck neighborhood. Shocking abundance of space inside this 5407 sqft home with exquisite quality at every turn! Open floor plan design with over 9' ceilings and abundant natural light. The formal living room has sleek linear fireplace and leads to the enormous Kitchen/Dining/Family room. Kitchen has Shaker cabinetry, top-of-the-line appliances, stone countertops, center island, walk-in pantry, a sexy reach-in glass wine locker and overlooks the very private back yard with pre-approved 16x32 Pool site (at additional separate cost). Also on the first floor is an office (could be 6th bedroom) w/its own full bath and a mudroom nook. There are 4 bedrooms on the 2nd flr, including a swanky primary suite w/sitting room, bedroom w/vaulted 14' ceiling, 2 walk-in closets, and a large luxe bath. The 3rd flr has 2 large flex rooms, (one can be a 5th bedroom), a full bath and closet; ideal for visitors, gym, play, 2nd office... The walk-out lower level has high ceilings and a ton of finished area, full bath, closet and wine cellar; unlimited options for your imagination! The yard has lush natural screening and new fencing for total privacy. Walk to: train, over 20 restaurants, golf, gym, water sports, marinas...The best in convenience, quality and lifestyle! Constructed by revered 30-year local builder Andy Frank.
